concepts.name: The loop that watches itself
concepts.world: Inside the agent's editing loop, a living pipeline diagram.
concepts.shows: The six-stage loop drawing on, a terminal session kicking it off, and the self-eval edge looping render back on itself.
concepts.money_shot: The self-eval node pulsing and the feedback edge firing a re-render.
concepts.why_repost: browser-use loves showing the mechanism, not the marketing.
concepts.why_stop_scroll: A diagram that loops back on itself is a rare shape in the feed.
concepts.light: Ink nodes on near-black, one accent node glowing; terminal plate.
concepts.argument: The strongest substance play: it foregrounds the self-correcting loop, which is the genuinely novel engineering. Risk: a pure process film can read cool but not bold, and the scroll-stopper (the loop) arrives late.

concepts.name: Never watches
concepts.world: A manifesto in browser-use blue-on-near-black: a video editor that never looks at the video.
concepts.shows: Wordmark, the raw-in cut-out claim, a real Claude Code prompt, the loop, the discipline, then the inverted reveal.
concepts.money_shot: An inverted blue flash: 'never watches' in dark ink on a bright accent field.
concepts.why_repost: It is the most surprising, quotable framing of their own tool, in their own colors.
concepts.why_stop_scroll: 'An editor that never watches the video' is a pattern interrupt you have to resolve.
concepts.light: Near-white manifesto type carries the frames; one inverted accent flash spends the contrast budget at the peak.
concepts.argument: Chosen. It is the boldest and most quotable, and the counterintuitive reveal earns the scroll-stop, while the terminal, the loop diagram, and the discipline beat give it real substance so it is a claim backed by mechanism, not a slogan.

concepts.name: Raw in, cut out
concepts.world: A before-and-after receipt: a messy folder of clips becomes one finished file.
concepts.shows: A split of raw takes versus final.mp4, one typed sentence between them.
concepts.money_shot: final.mp4 landing on a bright result plate.
concepts.why_repost: Proof over pitch, the transformation is the flex.
concepts.why_stop_scroll: One sentence turning raw footage into a cut looks like magic.
concepts.light: Split panes, a bright result plate at the payoff.
concepts.argument: The most legible outcome, but the transformation alone undersells the how, and a before/after leans on the same receipt shape ECC and caveman already used this week.

wow_bets: The inverted blue 'never watches' money shot, the one polarity flip in the piece
The self-eval feedback edge in the loop diagram (it grades its own cut and re-renders)
The terminal typing the real one-line prompt, edit these into a launch video
runtime_plan: 8 scenes, ~28s, a beat every ~3.5s, an in-scene event in every scene (words slam, prompt types, nodes draw, edge fires, field flips, curve climbs).
